subject: Gray Ooze
picture: A gray ooze lies on a dungeon floor like a thick wet stone slick with a few large bubble shapes. It looks almost like a floor puddle until you see the bubbles. Not a cube, not hanging from the ceiling. Stone ceiling, block walls, large floor slabs, closed wooden door. Bold even black outlines on white, same look as locked I-01 and I-02. White insides to color, no gray fill.
